title: Rightward move updates side words
statement: Let $\ell>0$, set $C_i=2\cdot 2^i$, and let $z$ consist of a home value and left and right lists at each index $i<\ell$, each of length at most $C_i$. Suppose the left list at index $0$ has length plus one at most $C_0$, and the right list at index $0$ is nonempty. After moving the configuration one position to the right, the concatenation of the left lists is the home value prepended to its original concatenation, while the concatenation of the right lists is the tail of its original concatenation.
